newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Roche with no buy-back, share split plans.
newsitem.headline: Roche with no buy-back, share split plans.

text.p: Fritz Gerber, chairman of Roche Holding AG, said the Swiss pharma group had no plans to either split or buy back its shares.
"We have no plans and would rather use the money for other opportunities that might arise," Gerber said in response to a question of whether Roche had any plans to split its shares or buy them back.
Referring to Roche's dividend payout ratio of around 16 percent, Gerber also said that shareholders were satisfied.
One of Roche's strengths is "that we have this high degree of self-financing".
Instead of paying back money, which tax payers will be taxed on, Gerber said Roche would rather use its funds to "expand the company without haste".
The stock market has speculated in recent months that Roche -- like many other Swiss companies -- would either split or cut the nominal value of its bearer shares or non-equity voting securities.
